sources.title: NSA, CISA, FBI Accuse Six Chinese AI Firms of Model Distillation
sources.snippet: The breadth of companies involved suggests distillation is a widely adopted strategy across the Chinese AI sector rather than isolated behavior by a few aggressive firms.
